Name: Action Valley - Makes Stardew Action game like
Author: aall137906
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3 New Combat style and mechanics are impermanented into the game[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The mechanics are best explained in demo video:[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]给游戏的三种武器加了各有风格的不同战斗机制，具体可见下面的演示视频：[/color][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1kRG26NEgq][size=5]Bilibili[/size][/url] (chinese)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://youtu.be/5SC6zgsU0fQ][size=5]Youtube[/size][/url][size=3](english)[/size][/color]
[youtube]5SC6zgsU0fQ[/youtube]


[color=#ffff00][size=5]1.Sword Style:[/size][/color]
[color=#fff2cc][size=4]Equips any sword to use this style:[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]1. Attacking any enemy with a sword to charge up your "weapon bar" (display at your hotbar)[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]2. When the bar is filled, pressing Special attack + another Special attack (on PC, it's basically [/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=3][b]Right click 2 times[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3] at quick succession) to upgrade your "weapon level"[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]3. You get a temporary attack buff for your upgrading, and your sword weapon level have been upgraded to the next level, as shown on the color of the weapon bar.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]4. You can upgrade your sword level 3 times, at max to Iridium level, where the buff is the strongest and longest, keep doing upgrade to refresh the  temporary buff.[/size][/color]
[size=3][color=#d4d4d8]5. Once at Iridium level, you can press Special attack + Normal attack (on PC, it's [/color][color=#ffff00][b]right click and immediately left click[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]) to perform an sword ultimate, dealing massive damage to surrounding enemies.[/color][/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=5]1.剑类武器:[/size][/color]
[color=#fff2cc][size=4]装备任意剑类武器即可使用此类机制:[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. 用剑类武器攻击任意敌人即可给你的“武器槽”充能（显示在道具快捷栏上）[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. 武器槽充满后，按特殊攻击+特殊攻击（在电脑上，就是[/color][b][color=#ffff00]先按右键然后立马再按一次右键[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]）就能给你的剑类武器等级升级[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. 升级后获得一个临时的攻击BUFF，并且剑类武器等级升到更高级，可在道具快捷栏上的武器槽颜色上看出变化[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. 总共可以升级3次，一直升到最高的铱星等级，此时获得的BUFF最强，也最久，继续进行升级则可以刷新BUFF时间[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. 到了铱星等级后，按特殊攻击+普通攻击（在电脑上，就是[/color][color=#ffff00][b]先按右键然后立刻再按左键[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]），即可发动剑武器大招，对周围怪物造成巨额伤害。[/color]


[color=#ff7700][size=5]2.Dagger Style:[/size][/color]
[color=#fce5cd][size=4]Equips any dagger to use this style:[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Attacking any enemy with a dagger to charge up your "weapon bar" (display at your hotbar)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. When the bar is filled, pressing Special attack + another Special attack (on PC, it's basically Right click 2 times at quick succession) to upgrade your "weapon level"[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. You get a [/color][color=#ff7700][b]permanent [/b][/color][color=#efefef]speed [/color][color=#d4d4d8]buff for your upgrading, and your dagger weapon level have been upgraded to the next level, as shown on the color of the weapon bar.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. Your weapon bar now start gradually losing progress, when the bar reachs 0, your speed buff will be [/color][b][color=#ff7700]removed[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. but as long as you keep attacking enemis to refill your weapon bar, you can keep the buff up indefinitely.
6. You need to let your current buff die down to upgrade to the next level, at max to Iridium level, where the buff is the strongest, at that time you should just keep attacking to never let the buff down.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]7. As long as you have [/color][color=#ff7700][b]any [/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]dagger buff, you can press Special attack + Normal attack (on PC, it's right click and immediately left click) to perform an dagger ultimate, doing a dash and damage enemies along the way.[/color]

[color=#ff7700][size=5]2.匕首武器:[/size][/color]
[color=#fce5cd][size=4]装备任意匕首武器即可使用此类机制:[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. 用匕首武器攻击任意敌人即可给你的“武器槽”充能（显示在道具快捷栏上）[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. 武器槽充满后，按特殊攻击+特殊攻击（在电脑上，就是[/color][color=#d4d4d8]先按右键然后立马再按一次右键[/color][color=#d4d4d8]）就能给你的剑类武器等级升级[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. 升级后获得一个[/color][b][color=#ff7700]永久[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]的速度BUFF，并且匕首武器等级升到更高级，可在道具快捷栏上的武器槽颜色上看出变化[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. 武器槽会从满槽开始逐渐减少进度，当[/color][color=#ff7700][b]武器槽归零[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8]时，速度BUFF解除[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. 只要你一直持续攻击，你就能不停重新给武器槽充能，从而让这个BUFF能一直持续[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]6. 要给匕首等级升到更高，你需要让目前的BUFF先消耗完，然后就能用正常的升级方式升到下一等级，到铱星最高，获得的BUFF也最强，此时建议就一直攻击来保持BUFF永久不断[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]7. 只要你[/color][b][color=#ff7700]有任意的匕首BUFF存在[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]，按特殊攻击+普通攻击（在电脑上，就是[/color][color=#d4d4d8]先按右键然后立刻再按左键[/color][color=#d4d4d8]），即可发动匕首武器大招，向前快速冲刺并给沿路敌人造成伤害[/color]


[color=#00ffff][size=5]3.Hammer Style:[/size][/color]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=4]Equips any hammer to use this style:[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. You don't need to attack enemy to charge your weapon bar, instead, holding the attack button (on PC, it's [/color][color=#00ffff][b]holding the left click[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8] button) to charge your attack, the bar will be filled with your holding.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. [/color][b][color=#00ffff]Release [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]the attack button to perform a charge attack, damage will be larger than a normal attack, and you will be doing a dash if you were moving when released.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. If the charge attack [/color][b][color=#00ffff]killed [/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]any enemy, you will upgrade your hammer weapon level, receive a temporary defense and mining buff for your upgrading, the upgraded level will be shown on the color of the weapon bar.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. You can upgrade your hammer level 3 times, with at least 3 enemy killed by charge attacks, at max to Iridium level, where the buff is the strongest and longest, keep doing upgrade to refresh the temporary buff.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. Once at Iridium level, you can first charge up your hammer, and press the Special attack (on PC, it's [/color][b][color=#00ffff]holding left click to charge up first, then press right click[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]) to perform a hammer ultimate, dealing explosive damage to surrounding enemies and [/color][color=#00ffff][b]rocks[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]6. But, that will consumes your current hammer buff, which means you need to charge kill another enemy to get the buff back.[/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=5]3.锤类武器:[/size][/color]
[color=#d0e0e3][size=4]装备任意锤类武器即可使用此类机制:[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. 与剑和匕首不同，锤子不需要攻击敌人来充能，而是通过按住普通攻击键（在电脑上，就是[/color][b][color=#00ffff]按住鼠标左键[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]）来为攻击蓄力，武器槽作为蓄力槽显示你的蓄力进度[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. 蓄力槽充满后，[/color][b][color=#00ffff]松开按键[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]即可做出蓄力攻击，伤害比普通攻击更大，而且若在移动中使用，会有一个短距离的前冲[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. 如果蓄力攻击[/color][b][color=#00ffff]成功杀掉[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]了任意敌人，你的锤类武器等级就会升级，获得一个临时的防御和采矿BUFF[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. 总共可以升级3次，一直升到最高的铱星等级，此时获得的BUFF最强，也最久，继续进行升级则可以刷新BUFF时间[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]5. 到了铱星等级后，先蓄力满，然后按特殊攻击键（在电脑上，就是[/color][b][color=#00ffff]先按住鼠标左键蓄力，然后按鼠标右键[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]）就能释放锤类大招，对周围敌人和[/color][b][color=#00ffff]矿石[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]都造成爆炸伤害[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]6. 不过这个大招会消耗掉你当前的锤类BUFF，意味着你需要再重新用蓄力攻击杀敌来重获BUFF[/color]



[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the files onto the "Mods" folder under the game directory[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]把压缩文件解压到游戏根目录的“Mods”文件夹内即可[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]（Not required but recommended）（不强求但是建议用）[/color][/size]
